claims.text: Google announced on 2025-03-18 that it would acquire the cloud-security firm Wiz for approximately $32 billion in an all-cash transaction, which marked the largest acquisition in Google's history [Source: ev-1].
This deal followed Wiz's rejection of a previous offer from Google worth $23 billion in July 2024 [Source: ev-1].
The strategic move was driven by Google Cloud under Thomas Kurian to close the security gap with competitors AWS and Azure [Source: ev-1].

By pursuing this consolidation, Google signaled its belief that cloud security represents the next major battleground in the ongoing cloud wars, while also betting on AI-driven cloud adoption as a key demand driver [Source: ev-1].
